description: bean qou-3quc/qou-idwf: the Molien-predicted Jones-Markov weights EQUAL the INDEPENDENT Wenzl Schur-principal weights y_lambda = s_lambda/Z as rational functions of (q,z), verified exact at n=3 and n=4. Supplies the independent general-z H_4 weight the n=4 full-identity Lean (n4_full_identity) needed; the two families share no inputs. Nothing wired.

data.wenzl_formula: y_lambda = s_lambda/Z, s_lambda = Q^n(lam) prod(1-R Q^c)/prod(1-Q^h), R=qz/(1-q^2+qz)
